Set up broader phylogeny to test placement of newarkensis

Trying: sampled_nwrk_ids see 102.2 for generation of m181.csv

```{r}
m181<-read_csv("metadata/m181.csv") %>% relocate(Species, Vicinity,`Tributary/Collection Location`,GVL_Code)

m181 %>% group_by(Species) %>% summarize(Count=n())

m181 %>% select(Path) %>% write_tsv("bamlists/181.bamlist", col_names = FALSE)
m181 %>% select(GVL_Code) %>% write_tsv("bamlists/181.names", col_names = FALSE)

```


Set up calls, see run_angsd.sh

```{sh, eval=FALSE}

srun -p bmh -t 12:00:00 --mem=128GB --cpus-per-task=12 bash -c '
 angsd -nthreads 12 \
-minInd 163 -bam bamlists/181.bamlist -out outputs/102/snps05 \
-ref /home/jsweeney/genomes/genome.fasta -r JBECYN010000001.1 \
-minMaf 0.05 -minMapQ 20 -minQ 20 -GL 1 -doMajorMinor 1 -doMaf 1 -SNP_pval 1e-6 \
-doGeno 2 -doPost 1 -postCutoff 0.95 -doVcf 1 \ 
> outputs/102/snps-05.out 2> outputs/102/snps-05.err
'
